INFORMATION / PRIVACY

A straightforward
approach to privacy.

How this website handles the information you choose to share.

Project enquiries

The contact form sends your name, email address, company (if supplied), selected service, and project message to FormSubmit for delivery to Orvanta Labs by email. We use these details to respond to your enquiry and discuss potential work. Contact submissions are retained by FormSubmit for up to 30 days under its service documentation. Please do not send confidential datasets or sensitive personal records in this initial form.

FormSubmit processes contact submissions as an external email delivery service. See FormSubmit privacy information. The separate WhatsApp link opens a conversation only when clicked.

External services

This site is hosted with Sites. Fonts are hosted locally. FormSubmit, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, GitHub, and embedded project media are governed by their providers’ privacy practices. Hosting providers may process technical request information.

What to share

Share a high-level brief first. Do not include passwords, confidential datasets, or personal records in an initial enquiry. Data access, approved providers, and retention requirements are agreed separately for each project.

Contact

For a question about information you have shared, email shakeelrana6240@gmail.com.
